'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[War crimes in the Gaza war]]
***The bodies of fourteen [[aid worker]]s killed on March 23 are recovered from a [[mass grave]] in southern [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]. One body had previously been recovered and one more is believed to remain buried. Of the sixteen workers, nine are members of the [[Palestine Red Crescent Society]], six are [[civil defense]] workers, and one is a [[UN]] agency employee. [https://www.cnn.com/2025/03/31/middleeast/aid-workers-found-gaza-mass-grave-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Kharkiv strikes (2022–present)|Kharkiv strikes]]
*** Six [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[drone warfare|drones]] hit [[Kyivskyi District, Kharkiv|Kyivskyi district]] of [[Kharkiv]], [[Ukraine]], damaging several buildings and injuring three people. [https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2025/03/31/7505286/ (''Ukrainska Pravda'')]
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**The [[Iran]]ian [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Navy|IRGC Navy]] seizes two foreign [[oil tanker]]s in the [[Persian Gulf]] and is towing the vessels to the country's [[Bushehr]] [[port]], claiming they are part of a "[[Shadow fleet|fuel-smuggling network]]". It is currently unknown what countries the vessels belong to. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2025/03/31/iran-s-irgc-seizes-two-foreign-tankers-carrying-smuggled-diesel-fuel (Al Arabiya)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Japan]]ese restaurant chain [[Sukiya (restaurant chain)|Sukiya]] orders the temporary closure of almost all of its nearly 2,000 locations in the country after finding a [[rat]] and a [[cockroach]] in its food. [https://apnews.com/article/japan-beef-bowl-chain-rat-insect-1fa6100fac147e43efc4b4a09ef25650 (AP)] [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/sukiya-rat-found-soup-japan-restaurant-shutting-2000-branches/ (CBS News)]
*The [[Caribbean guilder]] becomes legal tender in [[Curaçao]] and [[Sint Maarten]], which will co-circulate alongside its predecessor, the [[Netherlands Antillean guilder]], until 1 July 2025. [https://nos.nl/artikel/2561937-van-vogel-naar-vis-nieuw-geld-voor-curacao-en-sint-maarten (NOS)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Myanmar earthquake]]
**The [[Provisional Government of Myanmar|Myanmar government]] declares a period of [[National day of mourning|national mourning]] in [[Myanmar]] to last until April 6 as the death toll from the [[earthquake]] last week rises to over 3,050 people. [https://www.barrons.com/news/myanmar-junta-declares-a-week-of-national-mourning-after-quake-faee3b34 (AFP via ''Barron's'')]
*The recovery operation of the [[United States Army|U.S. Army]] [[M88 recovery vehicle|M88 vehicle]] that sank in [[Lithuania]]n swamps on [[Pabradė Training Area]] finishes after five days. [[President of Lithuania|Lithuanian president]] [[Gitanas Nauseda]] says that 3 out of 4 missing [[Americans]] are found dead, with the last person still missing. [https://www.dw.com/en/lithuania-says-3-out-of-4-missing-us-soldiers-found-dead/a-72093038 (DW)] [https://www.lrt.lt/en/news-in-english/19/2525052/lithuania-recovers-us-army-vehicle-from-swamp?srsltid=AfmBOooFIeD1JqZpTZp2lj3mWCqZE2Yd_QEIjTUsGNEQAzXcpp8MiZpy (LRT)]
*Five people are killed and four are injured in an explosion at a [[coal mining|coal mine]] in [[Degaña]], [[Asturias]], [[Spain]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c9dj1dx0y78o (BBC News)]
*Three people are killed in a [[multiple-vehicle collision]] involving a [[bus]] and a car near [[Heathrow Airport]] in [[Greater London]], [[England]]. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/home-news/heathrow-airport-bus-car-crash-deaths-roads-b2725169.html (''The Independent'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Australia–North Korea relations]]
**The [[Royal Australian Air Force]] deploys a long-range [[maritime patrol aircraft]] [[Boeing P-8 Poseidon|P-8 Poseidon]] to [[Kadena Air Base]] in [[Okinawa Prefecture]], [[Japan]], to monitor [[North Korea]]n maritime activities in the [[Yellow Sea]], including weapons shipments prohibited under international sanctions. [https://www.nknews.org/2025/03/australia-deploys-aircraft-to-monitor-north-koreas-illicit-maritime-activities/ (NK News)]
*[[Brazil–Syria relations]]
**[[Law enforcement in Brazil|Brazilian police]] arrest a [[Syria]]n [[consulate]] employee in [[Brazil]] after discovering over 600 smuggled [[electronic device]]s and other luxury goods valued at over US$700,000 in his diplomatic vehicle during a highway inspection in [[Ponta Porã]]. [https://g1.globo.com/ms/mato-grosso-do-sul/noticia/2025/03/28/vice-consul-da-siria-e-preso-com-mais-de-600-aparelhos-eletronicos-contrabandeados-em-ms.ghtml (G1)]
*[[China–United States relations]], [[Hong Kong–United States relations]]
**The [[United States]] announces [[United States government sanctions|sanctions]] on six Chinese and [[Hong Kongers|Hong Kong]] officials, including head of the [[Office for Safeguarding National Security|national security office]] [[Dong Jingwei]], accusing them of "transnational oppression and undermining Hong Kong autonomy". [https://www.dw.com/en/us-sanctions-6-over-hong-kong-security-crackdown/a-72101752 (DW)]
*[[Moldova–Russia relations]]
**The [[Moldova]]n [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Moldova)|foreign affairs ministry]] expels three Russian [[diplomat]]s and declares them ''[[Persona non grata|personae non gratae]]'' after accusing the [[List of diplomatic missions of Russia|Russian embassy]] in [[Chișinău]] of helping [[Alexandr Nesterovschi]], a pro-Russia politician convicted of corruption, escape to [[Transnistria]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/moldova-expels-russian-diplomats-for-aiding-fugitive-mp/a-72100437 (DW)] [https://kyivindependent.com/moldova-expels-three-russian-diplomats-for-aiding-fugitive-mps-escape-to-transnistria/ (''The Kyiv Independent'')]
*[[Proposed United States acquisition of Greenland]], [[Denmark–United States relations]]
**Newly elected [[Prime Minister of Greenland]] [[Jens-Frederik Nielsen]] rules out [[Greenland]] joining the [[United States]] while he is in office. [https://apnews.com/article/greenland-trump-denmark-ff85e2f04c5e967b1bbd7714b9972bf8 (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Killing of Zvi Kogan]]
**A court in [[Abu Dhabi]], [[United Arab Emirates]], sentences three people [[Death sentence|to death]] for killing [[Israelis|Israeli]]-[[Moldovans|Moldovan]] [[rabbi]] [[Zvi Kogan]] in 2024. A fourth accomplice who aided in the murder receives a [[life sentence]]. [https://apnews.com/article/emirates-death-sentence-rabbi-zvi-kogan-0c167275788c9c23df300a2f76fad60d (AP)]
*[[National Rally assistants affair]]
**[[National Rally]] politician [[Marine Le Pen]] is convicted of [[embezzlement]] and banned from running for political office for five years, meaning she cannot stand in the [[2027 French presidential election|next French presidential election]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20250331-%F0%9F%94%B4-french-court-convicts-far-right-leader-marine-le-pen-in-embezzlement-trial (France24)]
